changelog:
Initial release of github-developer-data-tools.

- Provides live GitHub repository metadata, audits, user profiles, releases, and gist details.
- No API key or signup required; pay-per-call with USDC via x402 protocol.
- Supports developer research, dependency due diligence, OSS analysis, and related automation.
- Simple HTTP GET endpoints for accessing data and audits.
